prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this original square painterly Mythics illustration of TLALOC.
CHANGE ONLY ONE ITEM: REMOVE THE ROUND EYE-LIKE MEDALLION located above his eyebrows in the center of the forehead/helmet. Remove it completely and replace that exact area with plain solid opaque unlettered dark teal cloth or a plain flat rectangular bronze band matching the existing helmet. Do not leave a circular socket, gem, eye-shape, hole or small ring there. His forehead and helmet must have NO third eye and NO object that looks like an eye. The deity has exactly TWO EYES, the two existing large ringed eyes below, and these two eyes remain unchanged.
PRESERVE EXACTLY everything else: same face and TWO existing ringed eyes (tlaloc-c16/c19), same TWO ivory upper fangs, same two hands and arms, same fully opaque garments, same helmet feathers except the removed central medallion, same jar grip, ONE earthen jar actively pouring the life-giving East rain water (tlaloc-c08), same waterfall/splash/rain, damp cave and mountain spring (tlaloc-c04/c14), same camera, light, color, composition and square dimensions. Do not add any new object, creature, eye, limb or held attribute. Keep indigenous deity respectful and imposing.
No text, pseudo-writing, glyphs, watermark, logo, border, frame, gore, nudity, extra eyes or generic magical aura. Change only the specified forehead medallion into a PLAIN featureless band.

visual_requirements.description: Two ringed/goggled eyes and large jaguar-like fangs on one readable face.
The East earthen water jar pours actual rain water into the spring with physical spray.

selection_reason: Not selected: distinct strong East-jar/cave composition retained; A has stronger direct lightning confrontation. Third-call targeted edit removes the rejected forehead eye-like medallion.
native_observation: Native inspected after edit: only two eye-like forms on face, the two existing ringed eyes; forehead medallion completely gone. Two fangs, both clothed arms and two jar-supporting hands intact; jar-water/cave action preserved. No extra eye.
source_generation_prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of TLALOC, the Aztec rain, water and earthly fertility deity, revered and formidable [tlaloc-c01,tlaloc-c02].
ANATOMY: one face with exactly two unmistakable large RINGED EYES, each eye visible inside its own thick circular rim, and two prominent JAGUAR-LIKE FANGS descending from the upper mouth [tlaloc-c16,tlaloc-c19]. A conservative one-headed two-armed humanlike divine figure, no extra heads or arms. Full opaque dark teal woven high-neck tunic and long ceremonial garments cover torso, shoulders, arms and legs; only head and hands exposed. Clearly counted two hands.
MOMENT: TLALOC leans forward from a damp cave entrance, bringing a huge earthen water jar toward the low viewer with BOTH hands and pouring a weighty waterfall across foreground stone. Face is above and behind the near jar, and both ringed eyes and fangs remain fully visible; he watches the gushing water with commanding concentration.
POWER: the EAST water jar dispenses rains essential for life [tlaloc-c08]. Actual clear water pours from the earthen vessel, hits dark stone and splashes into a spring, then falls as rain across nearby vegetation; do not draw magical beams or airborne energy. No lightning bolt, no second jar or extra held object in this composition.
SCALE & CAMERA: low three-quarter close view from beside the spring; his face, shoulders and weight-bearing two hands dominate the square; the tilted round jar and strong diagonal falling water make the lower foreground. Physical perspective, no giant-body assertion. Entire head visible, ringed eyes and fangs distinct at thumbnail size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single cold dusk shaft from the cave mouth hits real water and eyes; deep warm shadows inside, dense rain beyond, heavy white spray without luminous mist.
SETTING: damp treasured mountain cave and spring, documented cave/mountain/spring associations [tlaloc-c04,tlaloc-c14]. Plain rocks and plants, no invented temple, other gods or people.
SURFACE: rain-soaked woven fabric, tactile circular eye rims, ivory fangs, dark wet rock, aged metal or rough pottery appropriate to the held object, premium painterly brush texture. Low-key palette: warm walnut-black shadows, dark teal cloth, one brilliant silver-white light accent.
MOOD: overwhelming and awe-inspiring indigenous divine presence, composed authority in active motion; never an ordinary person, mascot, placid statue, or horror caricature. Original respectful design.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, pseudo-writing, logo, frame, border, watermark, signature, modern media/game/anime/comic designs; no nude torso or uncovered limbs except hands; no gore, victims, sacrifices or children; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes; do not add a jaguar body or animal head, because only ringed eyes and fangs are documented.
